reason: Both are US multi-state, physician/clinician-employing outpatient and hospital-based care providers paid mainly by insurers. Pediatrix sells neonatal, maternal-fetal and pediatric physician services, often contracted by hospitals. LifeStance sells outpatient mental health care (psychiatry, therapy) to patients, including children, through its own centers and telehealth. The care specialties differ. The patient and payer base overlaps only partly, because LifeStance does not staff hospital units.
